tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Create or resume one persisted review transport job from a canonical tracked handoff.

tools.name: recover_review
tools.description: Authorize one audited recovery reconcile for a terminal MISMATCH job after confirming that the original user turn was not sent.

confirm_unsent.description: Must be true to authorize audited manual recovery.

tools.name: get_review_transport_status
tools.description: Read a persisted transport job. Provide exactly one of job_id or handoff_file.

job_id.description: Persisted job ID. Do not provide handoff_file at the same time.

handoff_file.description: Absolute canonical handoff file. Do not provide job_id at the same time.

tools.name: get_review_diagnostics
tools.description: Read bounded, redacted transport diagnostic events for one persisted job.
